audience: churches, non-profits, schools and government organizations that text their members with Clearstream

useCases.title: Check the connected account and sending numbers
useCases.text: Read the account behind the API key. Then list the shortcodes and longcodes that the account can send texts from.

useCases.title: Review subscriber lists and their counts
useCases.text: List the subscriber lists with their counts. Open one list to read its counts and sync status, and list the subscribers in it.

useCases.title: Look up one subscriber by mobile number
useCases.text: Search subscribers by name or mobile number. Open one subscriber to read its opt-in status, lists and tags.

useCases.title: Review text volume and the text history
useCases.text: Read the text volume statistics for a date range, with dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Read the text history, incoming or outgoing, and use the cursor for the next page.

useCases.title: Send a text to one or more members
useCases.text: Send a text to one or more mobile numbers. Opted-out numbers never receive it. Use it only with explicit written consent from every recipient.

useCases.title: Add a volunteer to a subscriber list
useCases.text: Add one mobile number to a subscriber list. Use it only with explicit written consent from that person. Locked lists cannot change.
